transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess things have just been hard lately. Ever since my daughter left for basic training. I come home and the house just feels... dead. I can't seem to keep it together. I've been sitting in my truck crying before my shifts start. I'm a sheet metal worker, and I'm missing steps on welding jobs I've done for years. I've been snapping at the younger guys at work, too. And... I don't know, I just stopped going out on the water or working on my sculpture. I just don't see the point right now.
How long have you been feeling this way since your daughter left for basic training?
About a month. She left a month ago, and... yeah, it's just been like this since then.
Are you still able to enjoy things you used to like, or has that changed lately?
Not really. I guess it's changed. Like I said, I haven't been out on the water or touched my art stuff. I just... I don't really care to do much of anything right now.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
No. Like I just said... there's really nothing right now.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
No. I haven't.
Do you feel guilty about anything related to your daughter leaving for basic training?
No. I don't think so. I mean... she made her choice. I just... it's just hard. But no, no guilt.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns lately?
Not really. I mean... I still eat. Sleep is fine, I guess. Nothing's really changed with that.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
No. Not hopeless. I just... I don't really think about it much. Just taking it day by day, I guess.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
No. Just the normal amount, I guess. Nothing different.
Have you been feeling worthless?
No. I don't think so. I'm just... doing my job.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
No. Not really. I just... I go to work and do what I have to do.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
No. I don't... I wouldn't say that. I'm not really an anxious person.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy that you've tried to do since your daughter left, but didn't enjoy as much as you used to?

I guess... I haven't really been out on the water lately. Or worked on my sculptures. Since she left for basic, I just... I don't know. I just don't really see the point right now. The house is just dead, so... I just go to work.
Do you feel sad when you're alone at home?
I don't know. I wouldn't really call it sad. It's just... quiet. I don't really think about it too much.
Are there things that you used to think were fun, but now you're not sure if you would enjoy them if you tried?
I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't really thought about trying anything else. I just haven't had the energy to care either way.
Have you had difficulty concentrating on your work or other activities lately?

Yeah... I guess. I've been missing steps on some welding jobs lately. Stuff I’ve done for years, just... making mistakes. My head just isn't in it. 

I've been snapping at the younger guys on the crew, too. I just... I can't really seem to keep myself together right now. Sometimes I just end up crying in the truck before my shift even starts. I don't know. It's just hard to focus.
How long have you not enjoyed the things you used to like?
I don't know... maybe a month? That's... that's when my daughter left. I guess it's been since then.
Do you feel empty inside most of the time?
I wouldn't say empty. Just... tired, I guess. Everything just feels heavy right now.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed most of the day?
I don't know about that. I wouldn't say I'm just... sad all day. I'm still going to work. It's just a hard time right now.
Do you feel depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Like I said... no, not really. I wouldn't call it that. I'm just... I'm just trying to get through my shifts right now.
